name: After recital 1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2009/43/EC and 2009/81/EC, as regards the simplification of intra-EU transfers of defence-related products and the simplification of security and defence procurement
part_text: (1a) The European Union is not a military alliance. The principal objective of the Union in the defence sector should be reaching interoperability among Member States and strengthening the Member States' capacities in production of high-quality military equipment and research on advanced technologies. The Union should therefore focus on the removal of trade barriers and regulatory burdens, such as those associated with the Fit for 55 package and the European Green Deal, with a view to support Member States in their armament efforts and the growth of their defence industries.
